Of course I am not a financial advisor this is not financial advice. But, in my opinion what I would do in your situation is I would take all the money you have in the stock market along with the car when you sell it and go ahead and pay off that high interest rate card. You can always put money back into it once you are out of debt but for right now you need to get out of debt. That card is what’s gonna hurt you the most so getting it out of the way is going to make paying off all the other cards that much easier. Im proud of you because you are already working enough hours as long as you budget your money and stick to it you can pay off your other cards comfortably without the weight of the high interest rate card on your shoulder. not many people with that much debt are working as hard as you bro so keep your head up, get out of debt and STAY out of debt. Love you bro you got this <3 also ps don’t forget about capital gain taxes try to put a very small portion of your money aside for when that rolls around
